elsewhere.note: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong…
God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
Behold, the Lord has a mighty and strong one. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down…
and he who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day,” says Yahweh.
